answer: Reputation decay: each identity's trust score halves every few epochs unless renewed by freshly graded, verified work. A sybil farm can't park thousands of dormant accounts as a safe haven to activate later; each one goes hollow unless the attacker keeps paying compute for real answers on every account, every epoch. Trust must be laid down like basalt, layer by layer, so upkeep cost scales linearly with the number of fake identities.
